name: modern-opentofu-best-practices
description: Professional modern OpenTofu engineering best practices covering modular architecture & registry distribution, native state and plan encryption (AES-GCM / PBKDF2 / KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS / OpenBao), early variable evaluation & dynamic providers, remote backends & state locking, shift-left testing with native 'tofu test' (provider mocking, resource overrides, assertions), TFLint & Trivy security quality gates, passwordless OIDC CI/CD GitOps pipelines, resource lifecycle controls (prevent_destroy, moved, removed, import), and living README.md runbook documentation.
suggestedPrompts: Refactor this OpenTofu module to follow modern best practices, strict typing, and validation rules
Configure OpenTofu native state and plan encryption using AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS / PBKDF2
Author a tofu test suite using mock_provider and override_resource for credential-free unit testing
Set up a zero-secret GitHub Actions CI/CD GitOps pipeline for OpenTofu with passwordless OIDC authentication
Safely remove or migrate OpenTofu managed resources using declarative removed and moved blocks
